description: This file is the main FastAPI application for the Resume Insights Platform backend. It initializes the FastAPI app, sets up middleware, and defines multiple REST API endpoints related to user authentication, resume upload and management, AI analysis processing, and feedback summaries. It also configures background tasks for running AI resume analysis asynchronously.

classes.name: FastAPI
classes.description: Core application object for defining routes, middleware, and configuration

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify API is running

methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user account and generate auth token

methods.description: Retrieve AI analysis results for a resume

methods.name: get_feedback_summary( current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Provide a summary of feedback and science-based trends across user's resumes
